name: office
description: Generate Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx) and PDF files from content. All file paths must start with storage/.

skills.name: office-usage
skills.description: Guide for generating Office and PDF documents.
skills.content:
You can generate documents with these MCP tools:
- create_docx({markdown, outputPath}): Word document from Markdown.
- create_xlsx({rows, outputPath}): Excel spreadsheet from an array of JSON objects (keys become the header row).
- create_pptx({outline, outputPath}): PowerPoint from a Markdown outline where each top-level heading (#) is a slide and lists become bullets.
- create_pdf({content, outputPath}): PDF from Markdown.

Rules: outputPath must start with storage/ and end with the matching extension. Create the Markdown/JSON content yourself, then call the matching tool. If the user asked for a report, prefer create_docx or create_pdf. If they provided tabular data, use create_xlsx.
